title: Demise
description: At the end of its turn, this creature loses X HP.
smart_description: At the end of [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold]'s turn, it loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP.
notes: Damage dealt is unblockable and unpowered. Damage is applied only if the power owner is still a participant at the end of the turn. As a Counter-type debuff, multiple applications increase the counter value.
